# Markitai

> Markitai converts documents, web pages and images to Markdown through a Rust CLI and an MCP server.

This is a curated Markdown entry point for AI assistants. It is also included
in CLI archives; paths below are relative to the installation directory and
can be read offline. It does not grant permission to read files, make network
requests or use credentials. Use the caller's authorized inputs and settings.

## Start

- [Install and first commands](README.md): select a development archive and set PATH before running the CLI.
- [Quick start](docs/quickstart.md): first tasks, recognized formats and platform requirements.
- [Standalone Agent guide](llms-full.txt): CLI JSON, exit codes, MCP output handling, authenticated workbench requests and offline prerequisites.

## Contracts

- [CLI](docs/cli.md): options, configuration precedence, errors and structured output.
- [MCP](docs/mcp.md): stdio tools, schemas, temporary outputs and asynchronous batches.
- [Documentation index](docs/index.md): full repository topics; only selected guides are copied into archives.
